name: Mirage Spire
description: A crystalline tower grown from the cataclysm that created the Glass Desert. The Spire is not architecture — it is a wound in reality, a place where the seal-fracture energy crystallized into a physical structure. Inside, light bends in impossible ways, reflections show what isn't there, and at the mirror threshold the entire structure inverts. What ascends above becomes what descends below. The Mirror-Twin dwells at the Spire's heart — a being of refracted identity, neither the thing sealed nor the seal itself, but the crack between them.

rooms.name: Entry Hall
rooms.description: The interior of the Spire is nothing like its exterior suggested. The walls are smooth crystal, refracting light into slow-moving rainbows that crawl across every surface. The hall is circular, with a high vaulted ceiling that spirals upward into the tower's core. The air is cool and perfectly still — no wind penetrates here. A wide crystal corridor leads east, deeper into the ground floor. The entrance back to the desert lies north.

rooms.name: Prism Gallery
rooms.description: The highest accessible floor of the Spire's normal half. A gallery of crystal prisms lines the walls, each one containing what appears to be a frozen scene — a battle, a coronation, a funeral, a birth. They are not paintings or carvings; they are three-dimensional moments preserved in crystal, viewed from the inside. Some show places you recognize from the overworld below. One shows the Mirage Spire itself, whole and unblemished, before the cataclysm broke it. A passage leads east to the mirror threshold.

interactables.label: Unstable Prism
interactables.description: One of the gallery prisms flickers and pulses erratically.

actionData.noticeMessage: That prism is overloaded — the scene inside is fragmenting, energy building to a discharge. You avert your eyes.
actionData.triggerMessage: A prism shatters and releases a blinding flash of concentrated arcane light directly into your mind!
actionData.saveMessage: You steel your mind against the psychic assault, gritting your teeth as the flash subsides.
actionData.failMessage: The arcane flash burns through your consciousness like a brand. Your vision whites out and your thoughts scatter — when you recover, blood drips from your nose.

rooms.name: Mirror Threshold
rooms.description: The gallery ends at a wall of perfect mirror — floor to ceiling, seamless, showing your reflection with uncanny clarity. But your reflection is wrong. It stands in a room that is this room, inverted — the ceiling becomes the floor, the stairs lead down instead of up. Your reflection watches you with an expression you are not wearing. Set into the wall beside the mirror is a crystal socket, shaped to receive something. The mirror hums with potential — it is not a wall, it is a door, waiting for the right key.

interactables.label: Crystal Socket
interactables.description: A socket shaped to receive a specific crystalline object. The mirror wall hums with contained energy.

actionData.successMessage: You place the Shard of True Sight into the crystal socket. The mirror flares with blinding light — and then it is no longer a mirror. It is a doorway. Your reflection steps aside, and beyond it the Spire continues, inverted, descending where it once ascended. The Shard dissolves into the crystal wall, its purpose fulfilled.
actionData.failureMessage: The socket rejects the offering. Whatever this requires, it must show things as they truly are.

rooms.name: Reflected Gallery
rooms.description: You have passed through the mirror. Everything here is the same — and reversed. The gallery prisms line the walls, but the scenes inside are wrong: victories show defeats, the living are dead, the Spire is whole where it should be broken. The light has a cold quality now, bluish and thin. The floor that was the ceiling is solid beneath your feet. Stairs descend from here — in the reflected world, down is the direction of depth.

rooms.description: A sealed chamber off the shadow corridor, its walls lined with alcoves — each containing an item that looks real but is a reflection, a perfect glass replica with no substance. rooms.description: The heart of the Mirage Spire. A perfect circle of unbroken mirror surrounds an open arena — the floor is transparent glass over an infinite drop (or an infinite climb, reflected). rooms.name: Mirror Heart
rooms.description: Below the arena — or above it, in the reflected world — lies the Spire's core: a small chamber of raw, unworked crystal that predates the Spire itself. This was here before the cataclysm, before the seal-fracture. This was the seed. A single crystal formation in the center pulses with light in a slow heartbeat rhythm. Beside it, on a natural ledge of glass, sits a fragment of something older — a seal shard, separated from its parent ages ago, thrumming with contained power.
